pipeline.inspectNotes: Both ACs verified in diff: getClient() gates on telemetryBlockedForProcess()+resolveTelemetryEnabled() before constructing PostHog, so disabled capture()+shutdown() never invoke the constructor (AC1); shutdown() races client.shutdown() against a 2s setTimeout with finally-clearTimeout, and service.test.ts's hung-flush test advances fake timers to exactly 2000ms to confirm the bound (AC2).

claimHistory.reason: Added telemetry.enabled YAML schema and default, normalized merge support, environment opt-out resolver, and unit coverage.
Added atomic UUIDv4 install identity persistence under OVERDECK_HOME with mode 0600 and stable-read tests.
Added the 15-event telemetry contract, privacy-restricted per-event property types, contract barrel export, and schema drift tests.
Settings GET now reports effective telemetry enablement plus install ID, and generic PUT persistence validates and writes telemetry.enabled while ignoring installId writes.
Added settings-gated PostHog initialization, typed capture wrappers, anonymous install ID registration, and migrated all event, exception, and recovery telemetry call sites.

Added a navigable Telemetry settings section with autosaved opt-out switch, truncated install ID, sent/never-sent privacy copy, disabled-state dimming, and config equivalents; verified via tests and an isolated Playwright screenshot.
Added the lazy posthog-node write door with typed anonymous capture, runtime opt-out guards, server exception autocapture, bounded shutdown, and fake-timer tests; pushed commit 9319a3b5a1.

Captured typed CLI completion telemetry with allowlisted verbs and bucketed duration, routed every explicit index exit through bounded shutdown, added fake-timer exit-order tests, and pushed e75abdbb83.

Added non-blocking server_boot capture with bucketed project and live-agent counts, isolated failures from boot, passed tests/typecheck/build, runtime-boot-tested a throwaway Node 22 server on port 4321, and pushed b327c3fb32.
